items.label: All Weather Wicker Furniture Set
items.value: Sectional sofas crafted to endure every season, this outdoor patio furniture set features handwoven PE wicker and a rust-resistant steel frame. It stands up to sun, rain, and snow without cracking, fading, or peeling—ensuring lasting beauty and performance for years of outdoor enjoyment.

items.label: Ultimate Comfort & Support
items.value: This patio sofa set features thick 28D high-resilience foam cushions that keep their shape while delivering deep, lasting comfort. Wide seats(25.6"x25.6") and breathable back cushions offer full-body support for relaxing afternoons or long evening gatherings.

items.label: Modular & Versatile Layout
items.value: This 7-piece outdoor sectional set includes 4 armless chairs, 2 corner chairs, and 1 coffee table. Easily rearrange it into an L-shape, U-shape, or separate seating to perfectly fit your patio, deck, or garden layout.

items.label: Wide Arms, High Back,Full Comfort
items.value: Enjoy superior lounging comfort with 4" wide armrests that cradle your arms, while the tall backrest supports your shoulders and spine. This patio set is thoughtfully designed for both style and ergonomic comfort, making it the perfect porch furniture for cozy relaxation or entertaining guests.

items.label: Quick Assembly & Reliable Support
items.value: Sectional couch sofa Setup is simple with detailed step-by-step instructions. This modern furniture set ships in multiple boxes (which may arrive separately). Our responsive customer service team is always here to help—before and after your purchase—for a smooth, worry-free experience.

items.label: Oversized Waterproof Covers
items.value: Wicker rattan outdoor conversation set Made of 600D Oxford fabric with double PVC coating for all-weather protection, keeping your patio furniture clean and durable year-round.
